page_title: MON 1-0 ETI | Monaco v St Etienne 17/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Clement Turpin is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Lamine Fomba (St Etienne) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Philipp Kohn intercepts the ball.
90+4' Breel Embolo (Monaco) gets booked for the first time in this match.

90+4' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Gautier Larsonneur, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
90+4' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

90+3' Breel Embolo (Monaco) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Breel Embolo (Monaco) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The referee signals a corner kick to Monaco.
90+2' Lamine Camara (Monaco) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
86' It's time for a substitution. Jibril Othman (St Etienne) comes on in place of Ibrahim Sissoko.
81' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. George Ilenikhena replaces him.
81' Olivier Dall'Oglio has decided to make a change. Lamine Fomba (St Etienne) replaces Florian Tardieu.
81' The referee signals a substitution. Kevin Pedro (St Etienne) is brought on as a substitute for Marwann Nzuzi.

79' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
76' Adi Hutter is forced to make a change. Denis Zakaria (Monaco) is unable to continue due to injury, Soungoutou Magassa comes on.
75' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
74' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for St Etienne due to an offside in the build-up play.
74' The St Etienne players halt their celebrations as referee Clement Turpin makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
72' Goal! Zuriko Davitashvili provides Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort inside the right post. 1:1.
71' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.

71' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the right post. Gautier Larsonneur is alert and denies him with a nice save.
69' Folarin Balogun will be replaced by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco).
68' Olivier Dall'Oglio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ayman Aiki (St Etienne) replacing Benjamin Old.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) comes onto the pitch for Mathieu Cafaro.
67' Marwann Nzuzi (St Etienne) receives a yellow card for infringement.

65' That didn't go as planned! Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Philipp Kohn, who easily kept it out.
63' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) commits a foul and Clement Turpin immediately signals a free kick.
61' Mathieu Cafaro plays a pass into the path of Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne), who shoots way too fast from mid-range and sends the ball miles over the bar.
60' The Monaco players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Clement Turpin. NO PENALTY!
60' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Monaco as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
59' Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) jumps into a tackle and Clement Turpin signals a foul. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Monaco.
58' Lamine Camara (Monaco) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
58' Wow, what an escape. Folarin Balogun (Monaco) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Monaco are going to take it.

56' Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a decent low shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
53' Takumi Minamino nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Breel Embolo (Monaco), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
52' A pass from Vanderson (Monaco) is intercepted by Gautier Larsonneur and the move breaks down.
51' A pass into the box finds Takumi Minamino (Monaco) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the right side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Gautier Larsonneur denies him.
48' Benjamin Old (St Etienne) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
47' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) collects a great pass, spins and releases a rocket of a shot from distance. Unluckily for him, it ends well wide of the left post.
46' Referee Clement Turpin blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' It's a nice effort by Vanderson (Monaco) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Gautier Larsonneur. Easy save.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Referee Clement Turpin sees the trip by Takumi Minamino (Monaco) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
39' Marwann Nzuzi (St Etienne) collects a wonderful lead pass and as he has a lot of space, smashes a terrific shot from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the crossbar!
37' Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
36' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
35' The resulting corner from Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger. St Etienne win a corner.

35' Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Philipp Kohn pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
34' Lamine Camara sends over a penetrating corner which finds the head of Breel Embolo (Monaco), but his effort from close range is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
34' There's an opportunity for Lamine Camara (Monaco) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

30' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Clement Turpin to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Monaco players can finally celebrate. What a goal that is! Takumi Minamino (Monaco) received the ball on the edge of the 18-yard box and spotted the goalkeeper off his line. He set himself up perfectly and lobbed the ball over Gautier Larsonneur and into the net. Vanderson provided the assistance. 1:0.
29' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Clement Turpin wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
28' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) has a goal ruled out for offside!
26' Golden chance! Folarin Balogun (Monaco) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
25' Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Philipp Kohn, who smothers the ball.
24' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
22' Celebrations are cut short for Monaco as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
22' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Monaco players aren’t happy.
21' The ball hits the back of the net! Takumi Minamino (Monaco) keeps his cool and scores.
17' Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post.
16' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
11' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

10' Yunis Abdelhamid (St Etienne) latches onto a precise cross from the free kick and produces a header at goal from the penalty spot, but his attempt towards the roof of the net fails to beat Philipp Kohn, who makes a fine save. Good work from St Etienne as they win a corner.
8' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) finds a little space near the penalty spot and heads the corner from Lamine Camara goalwards, but the attempt goes miles wide of the right post.
8' The referee awards a corner and Lamine Camara (Monaco) goes over to take it.

7' Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The ball rebounds to Mathis Amougou (St Etienne) and he shoots from distance, but the keeper calmly watches it drift high over the bar.
6' Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
5' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Gautier Larsonneur comes off the line to clear the ball away.
5' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) hammers a powerful first-time shot from close range, sending the ball towards the left side of the target, but the goalkeeper stops it with a miraculous save.
4' Lamine Camara (Monaco) whips in a cross from the corner, but Gautier Larsonneur is well positioned and punches the ball away.
4' Breel Embolo (Monaco) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Monaco will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
2' Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
2' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) sends a long ball in, but Gautier Larsonneur comfortably gathers the ball.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Monaco will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Clement Turpin.
